slides.0.title: Heathcote and Rutherglen: Unique Victorian Terroirs
slides.0.subtitle: Level 1 · Module 4 · Lesson 2
slides.1.title: Heathcote: The Cambrian Soil Shiraz
slides.1.points.0: Location: 120 km north of Melbourne; warm continental climate
slides.1.points.1: Unique feature: Cambrian greenstone (600 million year old metamorphic rock) — one of the world's oldest soils
slides.1.points.2: Shiraz style: dense, structured, iron-mineral character — described as 'liquid iron'
slides.1.points.3: Very long growing season: warm days + cool nights create complex, layered flavours
slides.1.points.4: Top producers: Jasper Hill, Heathcote Winery, Sanguine Estate
slides.2.title: Rutherglen: Fortified Wine Legend
slides.2.points.0: Location: northeast Victoria; hot continental climate
slides.2.points.1: Famous for: Rutherglen Muscat — Australia's most unique fortified wine
slides.2.points.2: Grape: Brown Muscat (Muscat à Petits Grains Rouges) — sun-dried on vine before harvest
slides.2.points.3: Style: deep amber to mahogany; coffee, toffee, Christmas cake, rancio
slides.2.points.4: Four quality tiers: Rutherglen → Classic → Grand → Rare (oldest, most concentrated)
slides.2.points.5: Top producers: Chambers Rosewood, All Saints Estate, Morris Wines
slides.3.title: Rutherglen Muscat: The Four Tiers Explained
slides.3.points.0: Rutherglen (entry): average age 8–10 years; caramel, dried orange peel
slides.3.points.1: Classic: average age 12–15 years; toffee, coffee, dark fruit
slides.3.points.2: Grand: average age 15–20 years; complex Christmas cake, rancio nuttiness
slides.3.points.3: Rare: oldest barrel stock, 25+ years average age; extraordinary density, rancio complexity
slides.4.question: What makes Rutherglen Muscat unique among Australian wines?
slides.4.options.0: It is aged in screwcap bottles
slides.4.options.1: It is a fortified wine made from sun-dried Brown Muscat grapes, aged in a tiered solera-style system for decades — producing Australia's most distinctive dessert wine
slides.4.options.2: It is a light rosé from cold-climate grapes
slides.4.options.3: It is Australia's only sparkling red wine
slides.4.explanation: Rutherglen Muscat uses Brown Muscat grapes that are left to shrivel on the vine, concentrating sugars. After fortification, the wine is aged in small barrels under hot conditions (no refrigeration) for years or decades. Rutherglen's four-tier classification (Rutherglen, Classic, Grand, Rare) reflects increasing age and concentration — the best examples are among the world's greatest fortified wines.
slides.5.title: Lesson Summary
slides.5.points.0: Heathcote: ancient Cambrian greenstone soil → iron-mineral Shiraz with great depth
slides.5.points.1: Rutherglen: northeast VIC fortified wine capital → Muscat aged for decades in 4-tier system
slides.5.points.2: These two regions showcase Victoria's diversity — one a table wine specialist, one a fortified wine legend
